## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Palermo, Italy. It starts at Piazza Guglielmo II 1.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Unearth a hidden gem of Norman architecture at the Duomo di Santa Maria Nuova (Cloister of Monreale) in northern Sicily. Explore the art and architecture of this secret Benedictine garden.
>
> The Cathedral of Monreale is one of the best surviving relics of Norman architecture in Italy.
>
> Its highlight is the hidden oasis of its cloister, surrounded by no less than 228 dazzlingly carved columns.
>
> The centerpiece of the cloister is the stylised palm tree fountain. The monks use the fountain to wash their hands before entering the refectory. Pigeons use it to cool their feathers, and you'll no doubt use it as a photo subject.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €12.19. It was rated 3.8 out of 5 from 48 ratings and 26 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
